subject.title: fix(secrets): collect persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs

question: Should persona-level TTS SecretRefs become activation-time required under the current fail-closed secrets contract, or should this PR wait for the optional-TTS missing-secret policy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101204?
rationale: The collection fix is correct, but making these references active can convert a localized TTS configuration failure into a whole-Gateway startup failure; repository policy treats that security and availability boundary as maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep fail-closed semantics
options.body: Merge after exact-head runtime proof and accept that an unresolved active persona TTS SecretRef blocks activation like other supported active secrets.

options.title: Coordinate optional TTS behavior first
options.body: Wait for or integrate the narrow degradation policy tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101204 before activating persona TTS references.

recommendation.title: Keep fail-closed semantics
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head runtime proof and accept that an unresolved active persona TTS SecretRef blocks activation like other supported active secrets.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history most strongly connects this owner to SecretRef activation and fail-closed policy.
